# Lessons learned

Append concrete corrections and non-obvious invariants; preserve existing entries.

## Theme and tooling

- A successful content-script ping does not prove its injected CSS is current. Update only SmartFill shadow-root styles before tab actions and watch for replacement hosts, rather than reinjecting a second controller that could lose Undo state or duplicate listeners. Keep the shared overlay CSS in `src/lib/picker/styles.ts`.

- "Remove unwanted padding" means reduce excessive whitespace, not eliminate card and page insets. Keep text away from rounded borders. The user explicitly requires a light default independent of system appearance.

- Keep token strings importable by Bun: Plasmo's `data-text:` CSS import failed when picker unit tests imported the host. The current pure-TS token source and generated CSS avoid that bundler-only dependency.
- Edit `src/styles/tokens.ts`, then regenerate CSS through the development/build scripts; `tokens.css` is generated output.
- Theme convention: `--muted` is now a soft background; use `--muted-foreground` for secondary text. A legacy text use of `--muted` can become unreadable after a palette revision.
- Shadow-root controls register the local font through FontFace; do not rely on an `@font-face` declaration inside the shadow root. The generated font data keeps this importable by Bun and offline in the extension.

## Selection menus

- Search may be case-insensitive, but custom model IDs must retain exact case. Only suppress a custom option when the exact value already exists.
- A provider response can replace model options while a menu is open. Clamp the effective active index for rendering, Enter selection and ARIA references together; a fallback value alone leaves keyboard focus pointing at a nonexistent row.

## Storage and UI boundaries

- Follow `src/lib/settings.ts` for persistence behavior: settings use local storage with legacy sync migration. `src/config/env.ts` contains an older sync-storage comment.
- Preserve `SavedForm.pinned` when regenerating values; saved-form UI edits are behavior, not merely presentation.
- Keep injected UI in the existing shadow/top-layer host so host-page styles and modal dialogs cannot absorb its styling or interactions.
